data.content:
## Team News

Slavia Prague will be without the services of Stepan Chaloupek (hamstring), David Moses (muscular), Adonija Ouanda (muscular), Elias Pitak (ankle) and Danijel Sturm (muscular) due to injury problems.

Meanwhile, Lukas Provod (tendon) needs to be assessed before a final decision is made on his involvement in the Champions League fixture. [...] There is also expected to be a spot in the starting side for Tani Oluwaseyi, who has four goals and one assist in 13 appearances during the current campaign.

Slavia Prague possible starting lineup:

Markovic; Holes, Zima, N’Guessan; Vlcek, Sadilek, Nowak, Jurasek; Ayaosi, Suleiman; Chytil

Villarreal possible starting lineup:

Gulacsi; Mourino, L Costa, Veiga, Romero; Saliba, Gueye; Buchanan, Moleiro, Oluwaseyi; Mikautadze

## We say: Slavia Prague 1-1 Villarreal [...] Wiktor Nowak and Mojmir Chytil have netted seven times each for Slavia Prague this season, and the pair are both expected to be in the starting side.

As for Villarreal, Ilias Akhomach (muscular), Alassane Diatta (hamstring), Juan Foyth (muscular) and Gerard Moreno (muscular) are absent due to injury problems.

Georges Mikautadze has scored five goals and registered two assists in 18 appearances for the Yellow Submarine this season, and the 26-year-old will feature in the final third.

With that in mind, Jindrich Tripsovsky's men are 34th in the 36-team league phase table. They are plagued by injuries, with Bryan Adonija Ouanda, Elias Pitak (ankle), Igoh Ogbu (Achilles tendon), and Daiki Hashioka (muscle) sidelined for this clash. [...] In the Champions League, Villarreal are 28th in the league phase, having won one and lost three of their four matches. However, those defeats came at the hands of PSG, Liverpool, and Dortmund, and compared to these teams, Slavia Prague are easier opponents on paper.

Coach Inigo Perez will continue to manage a squad heavily affected by muscle injuries, with Alassane Diatta, Gerard Moreno, Ilias Akhomach, and Juan Foyth all suffering from the same problem. [...] There may be no changes from the starting XI used against Barcelona, with Peter Gulacsi expected to start between the sticks and Georges Mikautadze leading the attack.

These teams last clashed in a the group stage of the Europa League nine years ago. Villarreal have won one and drawn one of their two previous encounters.
